content.value: . An oil fired reheating furnace heats steel billets from 40 °c to 1220 °cat a furnace efficiency of 28%. The furnace operate for 4 700 hours per annum. The GCV of furnace oil is 10,000 kCal/kg and density is 0.94 g/litre. The cost of furnace oil is BDT 45/litre. The specific heat of billet is 0.12 kCal/kg <sup>0</sup>c.
(i) Calculte the amount of energy needed to heat 12 tons of steel billets per hour.
(ii) Calculte litres of furnace oil fired per tons of steel billets.
(iii) If the efficiency of furnace is improved from 28% to 30% by adopting ceramic fibre insulation, calculate hourly furnace oil cost saving.
(iv) what is the simple payback period if the investement is BDT 20 lakhs.
(v) How large could be the investment to improve the efficiency at an internal rate of 16% and per year over 6 years.
S(a). What is the purpose of material and energy balance? Distinguish between continuous process and batch process.
